about: RFC 8785 (JCS) number serialisation, the cases our canonical form must reproduce. Values are strings because several of them are not representable except as text in a JSON file that a human edits.
rule: ECMAScript Number::toString: shortest round-trip digits; plain decimal when -7 < decimal exponent+1 <= 21, exponential otherwise with an explicit sign and no leading zeros in the exponent; negative zero serialises as 0.

vectors.why: an integral float is written as an integer
the .0 suffix is not part of the number
the low boundary of the plain range
below the range: exponential, no zero padding
the high boundary of the plain range
above the range: exponential with an explicit plus
the largest exactly representable integer stays digits
plain decimal with a fractional part
